responsibility: Implements Solaris support that is specific to the C-family front ends. It defines the Solaris cmn_err format-checking tables for GCC’s format diagnostics and registers Solaris #pragma handlers for align, init, and fini, parsing those pragmas and either attaching attributes immediately or recording pending declarations for later processing. This file belongs to frontend parsing and diagnostics, complementing the backend-oriented Solaris support in sol2.cc and the macro/spec definitions in sol2.h.
